verdict.rationale: The evidence shows CLI preview/pull/push commands for config changes and a local dev dashboard, but nothing documents a distinct sandbox/test-mode environment with isolated test data separate from production, which is the actual sandbox story for a billing/entitlements platform. Missing for 10: dedicated test/sandbox mode or test API keys, documentation on isolating test customers from production billing data, and any confirmation that check/track calls can be run against sandboxed accounts.
